title: Psalms 62
paragraphs: ¹ My soul rests in God alone; my salvation comes from him. ² He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I will never be greatly shaken. ³ How long will you all attack someone — would you batter them down, this leaning wall, this tottering fence? ⁴ They only plan to bring him down from his height; they love deception. With their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah. ⁵ Rest in God alone, my soul; my hope comes from him.

⁶ He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress; I will not be shaken. ⁷ My salvation and my honor rest in God; my mighty rock, my refuge is God. ⁸ Trust in him at all times, you people; pour out your hearts to him — God is our refuge. Selah. ⁹ Surely people of low estate are nothing; people of high estate are a lie. Placed on the scales, they weigh less than a breath. ¹⁰ Don't trust in extortion or put false hope in stolen goods; even if your wealth grows, don't set your heart on it.
¹¹ God has spoken once; twice I have heard this: that power belongs to God, ¹² and that to you, O Lord, belongs steadfast love — for you repay everyone according to what they have done.
